basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast based in Minnesota with a penchant for swapping hardware and a love for classic comedy shows. By day, I work as a systems analyst, and by night, I'm often found browsing hardware forums and catching up on 'Kids in the Hall.' I'm also a proud owner of a coonhound named Rusty. My online hours are typically in the evenings after work and on weekends. I'm currently single and enjoy exploring local music scenes, particularly underground hip-hop.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and over a decade of experience in IT, I've developed a strong understanding of hardware and software systems. My passion for tech extends beyond work, as I frequently engage in self-study and participate in online courses to stay updated with the latest in hardware advancements.
